thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 11/14/2018: SNAP, XNET, ERIC, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/14/2018: SNAP, XNET, ERIC, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

organizations.name: us department of justice and securities and exchange commission

text:
Technology stocks were higher pre-market Wednesday.
Stocks moving on news include:
(-) Snap ( SNAP ), which was down more than 6% after reports said that the technology and camera company was subpoenaed by the US Department of Justice and Securities and Exchange Commission over its disclosures to investors prior to the company's March 2017 initial public offering.
(-) Xunlei ( XNET ) was more than 5% lower as the cloud-based acceleration technology company reported a Q3 adjusted loss per ADS from continuing operations of $0.22, compared with an adjusted loss of $0.37 in the same period last year.
(-) Ericsson ( ERIC ) was down over 3% after it said Wednesday that it has been contracted to provide Telenor with its cloud core solutions for 5G. The views and opinions expressed herein are the views and opinions of the author and do not necessarily reflect those of Nasdaq, Inc.
